Name: Multiplayer Sell Price Fix
Author: animavoro
Description:
Makes the sell price of items take into account the professions of players in addition to the host.

Without this mod the end-of-day sell price of items only uses the host's professions, despite what the receipt says to other players.

Using this mod causes the end-of-day sale of items to use the union of all players' professions.

Manifest.Name: Fix-sellToStorePrice
Manifest.Description: Causes the game to use everyone's professions when calculating sell price
